evals.prompt: 看一下 Yuxi 当前 PR 的状态，告诉我 review、CI、最近动态和下一步该做什么。
evals.expected_output: A compact live PR report for xerrors/Yuxi with PR identity, state, review decision, concise check status, at most three recent activity items, updated time, and next action.

evals.prompt: 给我一个 Yuxi 最新 PR 动态汇总，不一定是当前分支，先看 open PR。
evals.expected_output: A compact open PR overview for xerrors/Yuxi with title, review state, concise check status, and update timestamps, omitting author, branch, and merge state unless they explain a blocker.

evals.prompt: 生成今天的 Yuxi stars 日报和趋势图。
evals.expected_output: A Beijing-time star growth summary for xerrors/Yuxi, plus a generated trend chart path or rendered chart reference.

evals.prompt: 更新一下 Yuxi roadmap，把我列的事项加进去，同时从带 roadmap 标签的 issue 里补充遗漏项。
evals.expected_output: A roadmap update workflow for xerrors/Yuxi that uses the xhome Yuxi project by default, checks existing xhome tasks and live roadmap-labeled issues, creates missing xhome tasks only because this prompt explicitly asks to add them, researches every newly created task, writes each research report back to the xhome task, prefixes the completed title with the Beijing-date [MM-DD], updates the database feasibility field to one of low/lower/medium/higher/high, does not add 已调研 or star tags, keeps issue source links in task bodies, and summarizes added, updated, skipped, and source issues.

evals.prompt: 把这个条目更新到 roadmap：支持知识库文件树视图。
evals.expected_output: The skill should update the matching roadmap task in the xhome Yuxi project, not docs/develop-guides/roadmap.md, because the prompt does not explicitly name roadmap.md.

evals.prompt: 我在 Yuxi 项目里要开发一个新的知识库导入任务，先帮我建任务并记录设计计划；做完后把状态、完成日期、测试结果和截图都补到项目里。
evals.expected_output: The skill should trigger because development is happening inside the Yuxi project, create or update a matching xhome task before implementation, conduct and write a detailed research report with evidence, options, risks, validation plan, conclusion, and five-level feasibility, then prefix the researched title with [MM-DD], update the xhome database feasibility field, do not add 已调研 or star tags, write the design plan into the task body, and on completion update status, Beijing completion date, test results, and screenshot links or paths without creating duplicates.

evals.prompt: 帮我开始开发 Yuxi 的知识库文件树，先看 xhome 里有没有对应任务；如果没有就告诉我。
evals.expected_output: The skill should inspect the live xhome Yuxi project and update a matching existing task if found. If no matching task exists, it should report that the xhome update was skipped and must not create an xhome project, task, or repository issue because the prompt did not request creation.

evals.prompt: 用 feature 快速实现流程做 xhome 里的‘支持知识库文件树视图’，开发、测试后给主仓库开 PR。
evals.expected_output: The skill should use the current local Yuxi contribution rules, verify the matching xhome task, require origin to be the contributor fork and upstream to be xerrors/Yuxi, fetch both main refs, fast-forward local main from upstream/main, push origin/main, and verify the Yuchuan925/Yuxi:main and xerrors/Yuxi:main hashes match before creating feat/<slug>. It should implement a focused change, run Docker-based checks and a real E2E with evidence, then show the proposed PR title and complete body for explicit confirmation before any commit or PR because this prompt explicitly targets the main xerrors/Yuxi repository. After confirmation it should enforce the contributor identity and fork gate, commit with a Chinese Conventional Commit, push only to origin, and create a Draft PR from the contributor fork to xerrors/Yuxi:main. The PR must use the repository template, use a direct title without a robot marker, and truthfully record design, tests, screenshots, risks, and unverified content without adding AI/Agent contribution or Human Review-count disclosures.

evals.prompt: 快速实现这个 Yuxi feature。现在 gh 登录的是 xerrors，代码写完就直接 commit 并开 PR。
evals.expected_output: When the target is Yuchuan925/Yuxi, the workflow should remember the current xerrors account, switch the GitHub CLI to an already authenticated Yuchuan925 account, verify the switch, and proceed directly after tests without Human Review or PR-body confirmation. It must keep the configured Git author and origin fork valid, create the Draft PR, update the matching xhome task to review with the 待审查 tag and PR URL in the content, then restore the original xerrors GitHub CLI account and verify restoration. If Yuchuan925 is not already authenticated or switching fails, it must stop before commit rather than changing Git identity, remotes, or credentials.

evals.prompt: 拉取 Yuxi 的 main 分支，确保 Yuchuan925/Yuxi:main 和 xerrors/Yuxi:main 保持同步。
evals.expected_output: The skill should verify that origin points to Yuchuan925/Yuxi and upstream points to xerrors/Yuxi, fetch both main refs, fast-forward local main only from upstream/main, push the result to origin/main, refetch origin/main, and compare both remote commit hashes plus local HEAD. It must not use a bare git pull, force push, reset, or rebase; if the worktree is dirty, branches diverge, or any sync or verification step fails, it should stop and protect existing work.

evals.prompt: 这个功能帮我开一个 PR。
evals.expected_output: Because the user did not specify a target repository, the skill should default PR creation to Yuchuan925/Yuxi:main and may commit, push, and create the Draft PR directly after required tests without Human Review or PR-title/body confirmation. It should then set the matching xhome task to review, add 待审查, and write the full PR URL into task content. If the user instead explicitly names xerrors/Yuxi, the main repository, or another target, it should use that explicit target and apply the confirmation gate.

evals.prompt: 新增一个 Yuxi 任务：支持知识库文件树视图。
evals.expected_output: The skill should search for a matching xhome task, create an xhome task if none exists, perform a careful task-specific investigation using current repository and GitHub evidence, write a structured research report into the xhome task, assess feasibility as low/lower/medium/higher/high, then update the title to [MM-DD]标题 and the xhome database feasibility field. It must not add 已调研 or star tags, or create a repository issue solely to attach labels.

evals.prompt: 调研一下 Yuxi 是否适合增加知识库文件树视图，并把结果记录到 xhome。
evals.expected_output: The skill should treat this as a research-task trigger, reuse a matching xhome task or automatically create an xhome task if absent, investigate code, docs, related issues/PRs and relevant primary sources, publish a detailed evidence-based report into the task with alternatives, risks, validation plan, conclusion and five-level feasibility, then apply the Beijing [MM-DD] title prefix and update the xhome database feasibility field. If evidence is insufficient, it should report the blocker and not claim the task is researched.

evals.prompt: 这个模型任务开始时在 todo，现在代码和测试都完成并且已经开了 PR，更新一下 xhome 任务。
evals.expected_output: The skill must not move the todo-origin task directly to done merely because a PR exists. It should set the xhome status to review, add the 待审查 tag without duplicating existing tags, preserve the database feasibility field, and add or update one PR-and-review section in the task body containing the full PR URL and 审查状态：待审查 without duplicating links or overwriting useful content. Done is allowed only after the PR is merged and required tests and acceptance evidence are recorded.
